title: Atlas — preemptive_execution
description: make preemptive_execution local — febft PBFT. Panels are generated against the metrics this suite actually emits; see the 'About this suite' note for what its metric level leaves out.

list.name: host
list.label: Node
list.description: Atlas tags every point with host=NodeId(n): replicas are 0..n-1, clients start at 1000. Keep multi/includeAll on — the values contain parentheses, and Grafana only regex-escapes multi-value variables.

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.description: The `extra` tag: 'None' unless the run set INFLUX_EXTRA. Suites share one database and several measurement names, so filter by Run before comparing anything across protocols.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description:
Mean across replicas. Every replica handles every operation, so the mean is cluster throughput — a sum would multiply it by n.

Measured at the executor.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "OPERATIONS_EXECUTED_PER_SECOND" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Client request rate
panels.description: Summed over client processes — each drives a disjoint slice of the load, so here the sum is the real total.

targets.query: SELECT sum("rate") FROM (SELECT mean("value") AS "rate" FROM "CLIENT_RQ_PER_SECOND" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host") GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Client latency
panels.description: End-to-end at the client: send → f+1 matching replies.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "CLIENT_RQ_LATENCY" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Consensus wait
panels.description: Pre-prepare → handed to the executor. Roughly a consensus round trip for a standard executor, near zero for a preemptive one.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "CONSENSUS_WAIT_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

options.content:
**make preemptive_execution local** — febft PBFT, replica metrics at `MetricLevel::Debug`, clients at `MetricLevel::Info`.

PBFT ordering with the speculative executor: work starts on the proposal instead of waiting for the commit. The bet is that CONSENSUS_WAIT_TIME — dead time in the baseline — gets spent usefully; the cost is backtracks when the committed order differs from the proposed one. Judge the suite on those two together, never on throughput alone.

---
**Registered but not emitted here** (16). This suite passes these crates' `metrics()` to `initialize_metrics`, but `with_metric_level(MetricLevel::Debug)` filters them out, so no panel below draws them — raise the level in the binary if you need one:

`CLIENT_POOL_SLEEP_TIME` (Trace), `CLIENT_RQ_SEND_TIME` (Trace), `DECISION_LOG_WORK_DELIVER_TIME` (Trace), `DECISION_LOG_WORK_QUEUE_SIZE` (Trace), `MESSAGES_IN_CHANNEL` (Trace), `MESSAGE_DELIVER_TIME` (Trace), `MESSAGE_DISPATCH_TIME` (Trace), `MESSAGE_WAKER_TIME` (Trace), `ORDERING_PROTOCOL_POLL_TIME` (Trace), `REPLICA_INTERNAL_PROCESS_TIME` (Trace), `REPLICA_ORDERED_RQS_PROCESSED` (Trace), `REPLICA_RQ_QUEUE_SIZE` (Trace), `REPLICA_TAKE_FROM_NETWORK` (Trace), `REQUEST_SEND_TIME` (Trace), `RQ_BATCH_TRACKING` (Disabled), `RQ_CLIENT_TRACKING` (Disabled)

SELECT mean("value") FROM "LT_PROOFS_CLONE_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "STATE_TRANSFER_PROCESS_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "VT_MSG_PROCESS_TIME" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Host resources
panels.description: Written by the Atlas-Metrics OS thread every 250 ms. These bypass the metric registry and the level filter, so they are present in every suite.

panels.title: CPU per node
panels.description: Averaged over cores: OS_CPU_USER is written once per core (tag `cpu`) as a 0..1 fraction.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "OS_CPU_USER" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Process RSS per node
panels.description: Resident memory of the Atlas process, not the whole host.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "OS_RAM_USAGE" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Network per node
panels.description:
Bytes between 250 ms samples, scaled x4 to a per-second rate.

Caveat: os_mon.rs crosses the directions — OS_NETWORK_UP is summed from received() and OS_NETWORK_DOWN from transmitted(). Trust the series names.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") * 4 FROM "OS_NETWORK_UP" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") * 4 FROM "OS_NETWORK_DOWN" WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "extra" =~ /^$run$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
